thread:
Maya Patel: FYI customer reported SCIM provisioning sinks users but roles are blank — they expect group->role mapping to grant 'engineering' permission. customer says new users can't access Dedicated dashboard.

Evelyn Chen: Which IdP? Okta? Any error from our side or 2xx on SCIM calls?

Maya Patel: They’re on Okta. Customer attached a screenshot showing users created with no roles. They did the group->role mapping in our Console but looked like it didn't apply. No obvious 4xx in screenshot.

Liam O'Connor: Can we get the SCIM webhook delivery logs? I’ll check sync job for that org. Can you share the org id and a sample user externalId?

Maya Patel: Org: acme-corp (org_321). Example user externalId: julian.acme. I asked them for an audit log export but wanted to surface here first.

idp-bot: SCIM sync job for org_321 started at 2025-11-12T14:24:11Z. Last run finished 2025-11-12T14:24:13Z with 1 error. Error: HTTP 403 on /scim/v2/Groups?filter=displayName%20eq%20"engineering".

Liam O'Connor: 403 on Groups lookup — that usually means the API token used for SCIM lacks group:read scope or Okta app scim settings restrict group queries. Did they recently rotate the provisioning token?

Evelyn Chen: Also confirm they didn't enable 'Group Push' only for users. In Okta you can choose to push groups vs. users. If the Okta app is only allowed to push users, our side will never see group membership.

Sasha Romero: Quick repro steps for us to try: 1) curl the org SCIM endpoint with their token to list groups: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROV_TOKEN>" https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Groups | jq .
```
Expect 200 and groups[]. If 403, token scopes or Okta app policy is the culprit.

Maya Patel: I asked the customer to run that curl and paste output. They pasted an Okta admin log showing provisioning token rotation 2 days ago, and the new token was added as 'Custom session attribute' in Okta rather than the app credentials — sounds like a misconfiguration.

Liam O'Connor: If token was stored in an attribute instead of the app, Okta won't use it for the SCIM calls and the app will continue using the old/expired token -> 403. We should ask them to update the Okta app's 'Provisioning' > 'API Integration' > 'Credentials' field.

Maya Patel: Customer updated the app creds to the new token and re-ran the curl. They now get 200 and the engineering group shows up. However users still show role blank in Redwood UI.

Evelyn Chen: Two possibilities: 1) our group->role mapping config is attached to a different group name or case mismatch; 2) the SCIM group member link didn't include the user externalId we match on. Can you paste the group object from the curl? Look for 'members' array and 'value' values.

Maya Patel: Group object (redacted) from curl: 
```
{
  "id": "00g1a2b3c4",
  "displayName": "engineering",
  "members": [ { "value": "00u7x8y9", "display": "Julian Acme" } ]
}
```

Sasha Romero: Our mapping uses user.externalId == okta.username (e.g., julian.acme). But the group member 'value' is the Okta user id (00u7...), not the username. Okta's group member payload contains only reference to the user id unless you request 'expand=members' or map differently. We probably expect member.value to be the externalId for direct mapping. That mismatch would cause no role to be applied.

Liam O'Connor: In our SCIM ingestion we handle two flows: if members[].value looks like externalId (contains '@' or '.'), we match by externalId; otherwise we make a follow-up GET /Users/{id} to retrieve username. That follow-up GET failed earlier due to rate-limiting in their Okta tenant (429). I see retries were throttled and mapping timed out.

Maya Patel: Customer says they saw intermittent '429 Too Many Requests' in their Okta provisioning audit. They also said they had a big push of groups yesterday (1000+ changes).

Evelyn Chen: Action plan: 1) Tell customer to keep the updated token (done). 2) We'll increase our retry window for lookups for this org from 3s to 10s for Group member GETs to tolerate bursty 429s. 3) As a workaround they can configure Okta to include usernames in group members by enabling 'Push members' with userName mapping, or export a CSV and use bulk role assignment.

Maya Patel: Communicated to customer: we’ll do a temporary retry/timeout increase for org_321 and monitor the next sync. Also asked them to avoid large group pushes during the window.

idp-bot: Config change deployed to staging for org_321: increased member lookup retry to 10s. Rollout scheduled to prod in 30m.

Liam O'Connor: Follow-up: after prod rollout we should check: 1) next sync shows 200 for GET /Users/{id}, 2) role assignments populate in UI, 3) add a short-term alert if more than 5% of group-member GETs return 429 in 1h.

Maya Patel: Customer confirmed ~20 minutes after rollout that new hires created now get 'engineering' role. They thanked us. Closing when we pass the post-deploy check in 2h. :tada:
